title: Crans-Montana access — air, rail, funicular and resort shuttle
claims: Crans-Montana Tourism gives Sion regional airport as about 30 km away, Geneva 180 km, Milan Malpensa 220 km and Zurich 300 km.

By train, direct connections run to Sierre station from Geneva airport, Zurich airport, Basel, Bern and Lausanne; from Sierre the funicular reaches Crans-Montana in 12 minutes non-stop or 20 minutes with stops.
A free shuttle bus runs throughout the resort; Sion station is about 45 minutes and Sierre station about 35 minutes by bus.
Crans-Montana Tourism does not publish a Wildstrubel race-day shuttle in this access page; the official race page also says only the shorter distances have a paid shuttle from Crans-Montana.
